A Cartier sapphire ring sold for 3.4 times its high estimate at Bonhams Paris, the top line in this week's Carat Capital. This week also: Surat's bureau reports Bhavnagar's association estimates roughly 700-800 of 1,500 offices would be shut on sanctioned Russian rough; Lao Feng Xiang's net 107 closures cut nine-month revenue 44.67%; IGI's lab-grown jewelry grew 47% against natural's 3%; SNB's gold line swung CHF 7.6bn, H1 loss to nine-month gain.
